title: New avatars for Jira Product Discovery work types
description:
Jira Product Discovery now features updated avatars for work types in space templates. These new avatars help you better distinguish between different types of work, making it easier to organize and manage your ideas. To get started with this change: Go to your space in Jira Product Discovery.
	Select Space settings from the sidebar.
	Navigate to Work types to see the updated avatars for your existing work types.
